experiment.topic: Statistical Validation of Opening Range Breakouts in Crypto Assets (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD) 2019-
experiment.hypothesis: An opening range breakout with a 30-minute lookback and a 3% price threshold in crypto assets (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD) is statistically more likely to result in a sustained price move than a non-breakout event.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: Over a 12-month period, if 70% of all opening range breakouts in BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD fail to generate a subsequent 30-minute price move exceeding 3% in either direction, the hypothesis is falsified.
